purpose: Find trend-down bargain events: load daily closes, flag drops vs prior history average, optional short-term rebound filter, suppress near-duplicates, attach future price for supervision.

notes: Change DEBUG_TICKER in the file to inspect another symbol.

purpose: Parameter experiments: grid sweep of trend-down settings; Fortune 500 vs non-F500 rebound stats. Caches daily prices to a pickle for reuse. __main__ runs compare_fortune500_vs_rest(); call trend_down_param_sweep() for the grid.
notes: STATS_SINCE defaults to 2010-01-01 for summary metrics. Grid values are defined at top of file.

purpose: Backtest bargain vs index strategies since 2000: (1) Fortune 500 bargains, (2) DIA Dow-proxy on the same F500 signal dates, (3) all-ticker bargains. Fractional shares, no tax; reports cash, holdings, per-trade price_change, and P&L.
notes: INVEST_AMOUNT and HOLD_MONTHS are module constants. DIA is used as Dow proxy (Stooq US zip has no ^DJI; DIA starts 2005-02-25). Strategies 1–2 are paired 1:1 on tradable signals.
